title: Listening Drill — Bench shade survey
description: Fieldwork briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Bench shade survey
sections.transcript:
LEADER: Let me explain how we'll collect data about shade on public seating. Each pair will have the same instructions. That matters because another group needs to be able to repeat what you've done.

LEADER: Start with the wooden bench. Record the first reading at noon. The quantity we're comparing is surface temperature. Use the digital thermometer marked with blue tape.

LEADER: At the end, note whether the seat was occupied. If you miss a reading, mark it as missing. Don't fill in a number by copying the nearest result.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER.
Choose the option that completes the note.
